source: Thomas Bjørn Nielsen, email thread Renewtech x Relewise – input til demo på jeres data

mapping.name: g:title, unchanged
mapping.price: g:price, same list and sales price
mapping.availability: in stock => storefront value 10, otherwise 0; not physical quantity
mapping.relationships: explicit Component IDs, numbered chunks split independently at commas
mapping.market: COM represented as gb/en-gb for runner convention, EUR; DK as dk/da-dk, DKK

warnings: Curated subset, not full catalogue. Only shared market IDs with source images, prices and descriptions.
DK titles retain source English. No translated copy invented.
Margin Unknown is a sentinel, not a commercial margin. No discount invented.
No variants fabricated. Condition stock stays as source text.
Listed components do not prove selected-option compatibility.
Affinity groups and generated behavior are synthetic demo scenarios, not customer purchase evidence.
Generated guides, campaigns, personas and merchandising are demonstration configuration, not customer facts.
Products with missing prices excluded; configuration prices are starting prices.
No historical behavior or customer identities included.
